limitations: Full project test suite not run; targeted stages 428–437 and regression stages 170–437 verified.
External payment provider and sandbox not tested; real-money processing remains NO-GO.
Backup validation is a local structural/schema acceptance check, not a cryptographic authenticity guarantee.
Backup/restore tests do not establish disaster-recovery RPO/RTO, off-host durability, or distributed exactly-once execution.
focus: Read-only backup validation, no-overwrite atomic publication, incomplete/incompatible backup refusal, concurrent destination publication, reconciliation-audit preservation, and UNKNOWN-state recovery safety.
safety_boundary: Backup validation checks local SQLite integrity, schema version, required columns, execution-index definition, and record decoding; it does not prove authenticity or off-host durability.

Backup publication uses a same-directory temporary file and atomic hard-link creation to avoid overwriting an existing destination; filesystem-specific operational behavior still requires deployment testing.
Restore checks cover exercised local SQLite scenarios only and do not establish disaster-recovery RPO/RTO.
Local SQLite tests do not establish distributed exactly-once execution.
Real-money payment processing remains prohibited until provider and sandbox integration are independently verified.
